content:
A uniformly chosen point in the disk is proportional to area. For a sector, its area is \(\frac{\theta}{360^\circ}\) of the disk area, where \(\theta\) is its central angle.

The upper semicircle has angle \(180^\circ\). The three marked angles outside the shaded sector occupy
\[
40^\circ+45^\circ+25^\circ=110^\circ.
\]
Thus the shaded sector has central angle
\[
180^\circ-110^\circ=70^\circ.
\]
So the probability is
\[
\frac{70}{360}=\frac{7}{36}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{7}{36}}
\]
